title: Maximum events attended
statement: Event i runs from day start to day end inclusive; you can attend at most one event per day, on any single day within its range. Return the maximum number of events you can attend.

solution.explanation: Part 5's unlock, then choose: sweep days; events whose start has arrived go into a min-heap keyed by end day; discard expired ones; attend the one ending soonest. Exchange argument: attending a later-ending event instead can only lose options. Jump the day forward when the heap is empty, or a 10⁵-day empty stretch costs time.
